pf.license.background: Background checks only where the state's form asks

pf.services.capacity: One technician per booking; one install crew per job; the office's desk is saved with long sessions
pf.services.skills: Tests and estimates: certified testers and technicians. Installs: mitigation technicians. Wiring: a licensed electrician.
pf.services.nobody_home: A test needs access only to set up and to pick up the device: nobody needs to be home if the lockbox is set. Install day: an adult on the booking is reachable by phone.
pf.services.online: A result review can be a video or phone call (counts as at the office)
pf.services.smallest_job: A switch the owner sets: the smallest job taken, with smaller requests pointed elsewhere (the example takes a test or a system, and sends a single sump lid repair to a handyman).

before_times: What do you want done? (a radon test, or a radon system)
Which level of the home is the concern: basement, crawl space or slab?

after_time: Who will sign the contract? Everyone on the deed should be at the estimate visit

Pets at home during the work

pf.questions.who_may_book: An adult who owns the property, or someone with the owner's written OK. A renter's job needs the owner to sign.
studio: Which area, and a rough budget (on the secure page)

stop.words: gas smell, hissing near a gas line, sparking or smoking wires, a carbon monoxide alarm
stop.says: Leave the house now. Then call 911 and the gas or power company.
stop.booking: no booking; a new request must say the home was made safe

stop.words: a basement wall or floor giving way, a ceiling falling
stop.says: Stay out of that room, and call 911 if anyone is at risk.

steps_then_go_on.words: water in the basement or near outlets
steps_then_go_on.says: Stay out of the water and away from the outlets. Don't touch the sump pump or wiring. Call an electrician first.

steps_then_go_on.words: a worry about a radon test result
steps_then_go_on.says: A result is not an emergency. We'll talk it through on the secure page, and the next step is a retest or a quote.
steps_then_go_on.booking: goes on; the result stays on the secure page, never in a text

pf.safety.business_line: Questions about a gas furnace's venting, a well or a septic system, or what a result means for your health go to the business's own line

after_contract: The cancel window ends before any work or orders, where the state's rules give one

pf.visit.check_in: Estimate visit: the check-in code at the door. Each work day: that day's code, or the lockbox and a start photo when nobody is home. Office: the code at the desk.
pf.visit.at_the_visit: The estimator looks at the slab, the sump pit, the floor drains and the pipe route, measures and photographs; the written quote follows within 3 business days, good for 30 days
pf.visit.changes: A written change order, priced and signed by both, before any changed work. A second suction point, a cracked slab or a sewer line found are priced this way.
pf.visit.outside_checks: A permit inspection and the post-install test, where the permit requires them
pf.visit.done: The fan check and the post-install test are set, then the walk-through, then DONE; the care notes go with it. The test result is on the secure page, never in a text
pf.visit.studio_done: DONE after the consult, with the radon advisor's notes and the picks saved for the estimate
pf.visit.before_photos: The slab, the sump pit, the floor drains and the pipe route

pf.money.estimate: The example's $89 estimate visit is credited to the job; billed only if no contract follows. A free estimate is the safe start.
pf.money.no_money_before_contract: On project work, nothing is taken before the contract is signed by everyone on the deed
pf.money.deposit: Only after signing; the deposit cap comes from the state's form
pf.money.kept_apart: Money paid before the work is kept apart or bonded where the state's rules require it (a switch from the state's form)
pf.money.stages: No stage bills: a deposit at signing, the rest on the final bill after the install and the walk-through. Never ahead of the work
pf.money.last_payment: After the walk-through and the post-install test is set
pf.money.change_orders: Added to the next stage bill
pf.money.big_bills: Bank transfer through the company's own Stripe, for bills over the owner's amount (the example: $500); paid once it clears. A check also works: the technician texts 'paid check'.
pf.money.tax: Tax on materials and labor follows the state's form
pf.money.studio: The radon plan session's $55 is credited to the job if Alex signs; the $20 missed-consult fee only after Sam OKs it

never_in_texts: Radon test results and levels (the secure page only)
Contract, change order and permit papers (secure page only, with a copy by email)
pf.messages.minors: Never booked by a minor; a child at home is never the one who lets the crew in

pf.staff.roles: Technicians (Wes, Bea): estimates, quotes and running the job, with the crew. Radon advisors (Noor, Roy) at the office.
pf.staff.licenses: The company holds the contractor registration or license. Where the state's form also licenses each person, each one may add a number (optional, shown as given, not checked by Rosie). Subcontractors hold their own, as the business says.
pf.staff.who_oks: Sam OKs quotes and change orders over $500; Pat may OK them too, and Sam's answer wins
pf.staff.stand_in: Another technician may take an estimate visit; a job keeps its technician unless Sam moves it

pf.rules.contract: A written contract for project work where the state's rules require one, signed by everyone on the deed and by the business before any money
pf.rules.contract_parts: The parts the state's form lists (license number, dates, price, deposit, cancel notice, any lien notice)
pf.rules.cancel_window: A cancel window after signing, where the state's rules give one; work and orders wait for it
pf.rules.permits: Pulled by the license holder in the business's name, never the homeowner's
pf.rules.change_orders: Written and signed by both before the changed work
pf.rules.final: The post-install test booked and any permit sign-off before the last payment
pf.rules.lien_waivers: Lien waivers from the business and its subcontractors with the last payment, where the state's rules provide them
pf.rules.show: The license number on the listing, the quote, the contract and the receipt, where the state's rules require it
pf.rules.warranty: The owner's own (the example: the system is adjusted free if the retest isn't below the action level the quote names); 1 year on workmanship; makers' warranties on fans

pf.edges.test_conditions: A test during a storm, with windows open or a whole-house fan on, is not valid: the tester says so and the retest is booked, with no fee for the second set-up
pf.edges.device_moved: A device moved or switched off during a test: the test is marked invalid and rebooked
pf.edges.real_estate: A test for a home sale has a tight clock: the tester books it early, and the result goes to the person who ordered it, on the secure page
pf.edges.high_result: A high result is not an emergency: it goes on the secure page, with the next step (a retest or a quote). No result or level is ever in a text
pf.edges.slab_obstacles: Heat tubing, cables or a sewer line under the slab: the crew stops and moves the spot; the start may move
pf.edges.weak_suction: Weak suction at the far side of the slab: a second suction point by change order
pf.edges.backdrafting: Gas appliances: venting and carbon monoxide are checked after the fan goes in, where the rules require it; a carbon monoxide alarm is a stop
pf.edges.post_test_high: The post-install test is still high: the crew adjusts the system at no charge (the example's warranty), and a retest is booked
pf.edges.permit_late: The start moves with no fee; Alex is told
pf.edges.inspection_fails: The crew fixes it and it's checked again; the final bill waits
pf.edges.cancel_after_window: Sam and the customer settle it; Rosie moves no money on its own
pf.edges.nobody_home: Tests with the lockbox set, with start and end photos
pf.edges.over_license_limit: Not offered, and the owner is told why
pf.edges.walk_through_dispute: Goes to Sam; the last bill waits
pf.edges.other: All other edge cases are handled the generic way

notes:
Started from contractor (pattern: project, refitted Tue Oct 27 on the frozen master): an estimate visit, a written quote, then a contract and stage bills. Facts, switches, settings and money paths are the parent's, re-worded for this work: documents, photos, extrawork, firststeps, results, banktransfer, video; switch cancelright in flow B only (work sold at the customer's place); arrive A a set start, B a 2-hour window; cutoff 24 hours before.
Flow B main path visit|none|bill: the booking is the $89 estimate visit, credited to the job; Wes's written quote; the contract signed by everyone on the deed; $600 to start, $1,800 when the system is installed and tested (a $2,400 radon mitigation job). The $89 keeps the master's numbers true (97 master steps hard-code it); a free estimate is the owner's choice (pf.money).
B money paths: visit|none|bill, visit|none|own, visit|card|bill, photos|deposit|bill (Sump pit cover and seal, $640 from photos, a $160 deposit and $480 after). Left out: list paths. Radon test, charcoal ($179) and Radon retest ($150) are in pf.services, but the master's booking cards name one list service, so a list path would show the wrong name (MASTER R02/R08).
Flow A is Sam's second company, Lee Radon Office, Lee Radon Office, a radon advice office (the master's Lee's Barbershop). Main path list|card|counter: a $35 result review with Noor, a card saved for the $20 missed-consult fee, paid at the office desk. The other three: list|none|counter, list|full|none (radon plan session, $55, credited to the job if Alex signs), list|deposit|counter (home radon plan, $140, $40 deposit and $100 after the visit). Video or phone result reviews are on (fact `video`): the owner's printed report and basement photos are enough to talk through the next step, so the A4-01 video branch is on.
Own steps: A8-x01 (the result review offers the estimate visit at home), B8-x06 to B8-x08 (the permit and the slab scan go first; a late permit moves the start with no fee; heat tubing or a cable in the slab means moving the drilling spot) and B8-x11 / B8-x12 (weak suction at the far side of the slab: a second suction point by change order first, signed by both).
Radon work is a one-day install with no stage bills (fact `stages` and `multiday` are not listed): a 25% deposit at signing and the rest on the final bill after the install; the quote lines and the day pick say so with pairs (B8-62, B8-63). A test result is never in a text: every text says it is on the secure page (pf.messages, pf.edges high_result), and the radon level is in no owner or staff text. A test needs closed-house conditions (pf.first_steps prep, pf.edges test_conditions); a mitigation needs the slab scanned before drilling (B8-x06); a gas smell, a carbon monoxide alarm, sparking wires or a failing wall are stops (pf.safety); water in the basement near outlets is safety steps then the booking goes on, marked urgent.
Booking choices: B timing settime, times window; A times setstart. Nothing is sent now: the S2-30 'Yes' branch is off, no `sentnow` fact, and the two rows that spoke of it say so (S2-30's example sentence and S1-21's 'Jobs sent now' row now read that every job is booked ahead). I searched the joined text of all eight paths for the opposite claim: only the master's own conditional lines remain ('A job sent now reads ...' in B6-13, S13-32), hidden branches aside.
Dates (not the parent's): the own steps run forward from the cancel window (ends Tue Oct 27) to the first work day Mon Nov 2: the permit to-do is Wed Oct 28 'due before the first work day, Mon Nov 2'; a late permit Fri Oct 30 with new starts Mon Nov 9 / Mon Nov 16; the trade's surprise at the lab or locate Thu Oct 29; the change order on a work day, Tue Nov 3.
Test results, health and money details stay off texts: the lab or test result is 'on your secure page' in every text (B8-x08), and special care needs at home are asked only on the secure page (pf.questions secure_page_only).
Plug-in splits kept whole (splitsKept): A7-15; B5-34, B7-55, B8-58, B8-69 (as the parent).
Names: Wes and Bea are the crew leads (the master's Jordan and Casey), Noor and Roy the radon advisors (Riley and Avery). None of them is a master customer's name. Addresses: 88 Foundry Ave (the company), 21 Market Sq (the office), 14 Linden Ct (Alex). License numbers use an obviously fake format (RM-1042, RT-2210, RO-3305; people RM-10552, RT-10417). No state, city or law is named.
Every state rule is a switch from the state's form: the license and its job-size limit, the written contract and its parts, the deposit cap, money kept apart, the cancel window, permits, lien waivers, what must be shown.
keep: color (the master's protected-classes line in S13-40 says 'race, color, religion or sex'), pipe, valve and leak (this trade's own words), the estimate visit, roofing (the work it doesn't do).
Rename: the contractor's pairs re-worded for this work (master sentences first, then phrases, then single words); the barbershop's 'cut' and 'hair' words and its price-board words are turned into this work's words (S1-38, S1-60, S13-55, B8-34); the A3-22 / A3-23 lines that said the plug-in has no danger words now name this work's.
